In fact, Johnson tallied just 10 offensive snaps, finishing behind both starter James Cook (35) and fellow backup Ray Davis (12). Johnson has had a few productive performances as a pass catcher this season, but his role is too unpredictable to warrant weekly fantasy consideration.

It's not immediately clear when he suffered the back injury, but Reed-Adams will now have to sit out at least four games as he recovers. His absence leaves veteran Austin Corbett as Buffalo's undisputed backup plan at guard behind starters Alec Anderson and O'Cyrus Torrence.

Bass made a 37-yard field goal in the second quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker continues his perfect streak, having made all 20 of his field-goal attempts so far in 2026, with three such conversions coming from beyond 50 yards.

Knox continues to receive targets as the No. 2 tight end in the Bills offense. The 30-year-old has consistently struggled to bring in catchable balls over the past few contests but remains a valuable part of Buffalo's 13-personnel packages as a blocker and receiving threat. Knox played 41 offensive snaps in Sunday's game and was on the field for 72 percent of the Bills' offensive plays.

Coleman failed to reel in multiple passes for the third time in the team's last five contests, and he played just 52 percent of the team's offensive snaps in the contest, his lowest percentage since Week 1. The wide receiver was briefly sidelined while being evaluated for a head injury before returning to the contest, which likely contributed to his lower workload. Coleman will continue to be an unpredictable fantasy option in Week 11 versus the Dolphins.

home.injury_description: Jonah Monheim will draw the start at center in place of Hainsey, who exited this past Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans due to a knee sprain, per Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com. According to Fowler, Hainsey's knee injury isn't considered season-ending, but the veteran lineman is viewed as week-to-week and could be a candidate for injured reserve.

Sunday was the third time in nine regular-season games that Oluokun played every single defensive snap and the second time that he reached double-digit tackles. His nine solo stops were a season high and most in a game since Week 1 of the 2024 season. Oluokun has accumulated 44 tackles (30 solo), including 2.0 sacks, over his last five outings.

Little was able to make four field-goal tries for the second straight week, converting attempts from 46, 48, 36 and 40 yards in the contest. The kicker has now gone 18-for-20 on field-goal attempts, including 4-for-6 from 50-plus yards, over nine contests during the 2026 campaign.

Fifty-six of Hunter's 62 snaps Sunday came on defense, and that's where he made his biggest impact with a diving interception on a Cam Ward pass intended for Elic Ayomanor, and the Jaguars offense converted that takeaway into a field goal 10 plays later. Hunter's impact on both sides of the ball has been undeniable: he has 28 catches (on 45 targets) for 298 yards and a touchdown, along with 36 tackles (24 solo) and seven pass defenses (including three interceptions) through nine regular-season games. The Jaguars will hit the road for Week 11 against the Giants on Nov. 22.

Pittsburgh gave up 38 points, so it wasn't exactly a stellar performance by the team's defense. However, three different Steelers players logged double-digit tackles -- including Brisker, who finished with 10. That's a season-high mark for the veteran safety, who has finished with at least six stops in all but one of his nine games so far this season.

Cincinnati blew out the Steelers on Sunday, but Queen nonetheless managed to put up a hearty IDP fantasy line. The veteran linebacker not only recorded a season-high 14 stops, he also got into the sacks column for the third straight game when he brought down Joe Burrow just before the end of the first quarter. Queen has 3.5 sacks over his past three contests after notching just 2.0 sacks across his previous two regular seasons combined.

Wilson not only set a career high with his 19 stops, he also tied the NFL high mark by any player so far this season. The third-year linebacker has jumped up a notch as an IDP asset in 2026, as he's tied for sixth in the league with 88 stops through nine games. Wilson has also added a sack, three defensed passes (including one interception) and a fumble recovery.

Smith played a season-high 47 offensive snaps (77 percent) in Week 10, and he was able to reel in multiple passes for the second time in three weeks. He ranked third at his position in snaps on offense behind Germie Bernard (58) and DK Metcalf (50) while being far ahead of the next closest wideout Ben Skowronek (10). With Roman Wilson (finger) trending toward a potential activation from injured reserve  ahead of Week 11, Smith could find himself back in a limited role on offense against the Eagles on Sunday.
